description: Look up an IP address or CIDR block via RIR RDAP (ARIN, RIPE, APNIC, LACNIC, AFRINIC — auto-routed via IANA bootstrap). Returns netblock, org, country, CIDR, abuse contact email, and reverse DNS (PTR) via DoH. PTR is best-effort — failure returns ptr: null. Private/reserved ranges (RFC 1918, loopback, link-local) return a validation error — no RIR RDAP record exists for them.

ip.description: IPv4 address (e.g., "8.8.8.8"), IPv6 address (e.g., "2001:4860:4860::8888"), or CIDR notation (e.g., "192.0.2.0/24"). Private/reserved ranges will return a validation error.

name: whois_lookup_ip

country.description: Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Omitted when not in RDAP data.

end_address.description: End address of the IP netblock.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_ip`: Input is not a valid IPv4, IPv6, or CIDR address. `private_range`: Input is a private or reserved range — no RIR RDAP record exists for it. `ip_not_found`: RIR RDAP returned 404 — no netblock record for this address. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

name.description: Network name assigned by the RIR.

ptr.description: Reverse DNS hostname (PTR record). Null when PTR lookup fails, returns no answer, or domain is NXDOMAIN.

rdap_source.description: RIR that provided the RDAP data (ARIN, RIPE, APNIC, LACNIC, AFRINIC).

start_address.description: Start address of the IP netblock.

title: IP Address / Network Lookup
